question: What did the people do with the cart and the cows?
options: They sent them back to the Philistines
They chopped up the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering
They kept them to carry the ark
They gave them to the priests of Shiloh

places.name: Field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh

explanation: The people chopped up the wood of the cart and sacrificed the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
